name: worktrees
description: A /worktrees pane listing the current repo's git worktrees with branch, dirty files, ahead/behind, last commit, and lock/prunable markers; copy a path or insert a cd from any row

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often the pane refreshes while it is open. 0 turns automatic refresh off; the Refresh button still works.

max_parallel.title: Parallel worktree checks
max_parallel.description: How many worktrees are inspected at once (each check runs git status and git log).

row_action.title: Row button
row_action.description: What the button on each worktree row does: copy its path to the clipboard, insert `cd <path>` into the prompt, or no button.
